name: Vitamin A
effects: Fat-soluble vitamin — vision (rhodopsin), immune function, epithelial integrity
Preformed retinol is teratogenic in excess — strict avoidance in pregnancy above 10,000 IU/day
Beta-carotene (provitamin A) non-toxic in excess — conversion is regulated
Carotenodermia (yellow-orange skin) with excess beta-carotene — harmless
Hypervitaminosis A: headache, nausea, bone pain, liver damage at chronic high doses
Beta-carotene supplementation linked to lung cancer risk increase in smokers
